name: volume_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing directional orders leave a measurable volume fingerprint: when more than 62% of the last 100 seconds of traded volume lands on up-bars (5-second candles closing above their open), it signals sustained buy-side order flow rather than noise. When this volume skew aligns with spot trading above session VWAP and a positive 60-second rate-of-change, the remaining unfilled institutional queue pushes NIFTY 15-25 spot points higher in the next 30-90 seconds — we buy ATM CE to capture approximately half of that continuation. The symmetrical condition (volume skew toward down-bars, below VWAP, negative 60s ROC) signals sell-side institutional flow and we buy PE.

indicators.name: up_vol_ratio_20
indicators.purpose: 20 bars = 100 seconds — recent enough to reflect current institutional flow direction without being contaminated by volume from 5+ minutes ago. Original used 20 bars on 1-min (20 minutes); we compress to 20 bars at 5s because we hold 30-90 seconds, not 15-40 minutes. The ratio needs at least 10-15 bars to be statistically meaningful, so 20 is the minimum reliable window.

indicators.name: roc_12
indicators.purpose: 12 bars = 60 seconds (1 minute). Original used ROC(10) on 1-min bars = 10 minutes. We compress to 1 minute because we target 30-90 second holds — the directional trigger should confirm a move that started in the last minute, not 10 minutes ago. A 1-minute ROC above 0.10% on NIFTY (roughly 22 spot pts) confirms momentum is already in progress.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative(typical_price * volume) / cumulative(volume) from session open
indicators.purpose: No scaling — cumulative from 09:15. VWAP is the institutional benchmark; trades above VWAP are buy-side dominated (institutions getting filled at or below benchmark). Unchanged from original.

indicators.name: vol_sma_24
indicators.formula: SMA(volume, 24) — rolling 2-minute average (prior 24 bars, excluding current)
indicators.purpose: 24 bars = 120 seconds. Current bar volume vs 2-minute rolling average confirms this is an active bar, not a thin-volume noise spike. The 2-minute window is tight enough to reflect current session regime without smoothing out intraday volume surges.

indicators.name: vol_ratio_trend_6
indicators.purpose: 6 bars = 30 seconds. Checks whether institutional volume participation in the direction is INCREASING in the last 30 seconds — confirming momentum is accelerating rather than stalling. This replaces the original's confirmation condition (vol_ratio[t] > vol_ratio[t-5] on 1-min bars = 5 minutes). Compressed to 6 bars because at 5s resolution we want to detect acceleration in the last 30 seconds, not the last 5 minutes.

conditions: up_vol_ratio_20 > 0.62 (>62% of last 100s volume in up-bars)
volume[t] > vol_sma_24 (current bar volume above 2-min average)
up_vol_ratio_20 < 0.38 (<38% of last 100s volume in up-bars, i.e. >62% in down-bars)
volume[t] > vol_sma_24 (current bar volume above 2-min average)

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points = ~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5. On a 30-90 second institutional momentum trade, if the spot retraces 8 pts against us the volume thesis is broken — the order queue has reversed or exhausted. NIFTY 30-second moves are typically 2-5 option pts, so a 4-pt stop gives one full typical adverse move before cutting.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points = ~14 NIFTY spot points. Institutional-backed NIFTY momentum runs 15-25 spot pts in 60-90 seconds; 7 option pts captures ~50-60% of the expected move, matching the 1-2 minute typical move range from the calibration table. R:R of 1:1.75.

filters.vix_filter: none — strategy relies on volume ratio rather than volatility regime
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST; skip first 10 minutes to let opening volume settle
filters.volume_filter: integrated — current bar volume > 2-minute rolling average (vol_sma_24)
filters.trend_filter: VWAP alignment ensures we trade with institutional benchmark direction
filters.spread_filter: not applicable — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — up/down volume ratio is a non-standard custom indicator not available in mainstream charting platforms; order-flow structural dynamics are persistent

adaptation_notes: Key changes from original: (1) dropped stock universe filter — NIFTY index is the single underlying; (2) compressed all lookbacks from 1-min to 5-second equivalents targeting 30-90s holds; (3) removed bid-ask spread filter (limit order execution); (4) ROC threshold lowered from 0.15% to 0.10% because index moves are smoother and a 0.10% NIFTY 60s move (~22 pts) is already meaningful; (5) stops/targets in option premium points not percentage; (6) ADV and avg_bar_volume stock filters eliminated entirely.
weaknesses: NIFTY volume data at 5-second resolution can have gaps (zero-volume bars during illiquid seconds) which distort the rolling volume ratio
Up/down bar classification (close > open) is sensitive to where in the 5s bar the volume actually traded — a bar can close green on entirely sell-initiated volume
Volume ratio can be momentarily skewed by large expiry-day rolls or basket trades unrelated to directional flow
False signals possible when VWAP and momentum align but the move is mean-reverting off an intraday extreme
